contract.baseline: Forward acceptance contract for the two Sprint 4 routes. Based on Sprint 3A commit e4294f980c2c8506bd00bd48edb4ddbd5ea81e00.

replay.instructions: Use an authenticated staff test session with the companion seed-data.json in its tenant. Freeze the server lookup clock to the snapshot below. For each case, POST parse_bill.request, then margin_check.request. Compare the complete decoded bodies to the corresponding expected objects with deep equality. Array order is significant. Reject extra keys at every depth. Requests are independent: the confirmed margin request simulates a clerk reviewing the quote. No real invoice is saved.

extraction: Only return recognized bill type, customer/item references, explicitly mentioned draft fields and stable warnings. All optional scalar fields in these responses are present and null when unavailable; arrays use []. Preserve incoming line order. Missing optional freight or dimensions alone need no warning.

Echo customer_query, item_query, rate_mention, transport_mention and charge mention as exact transcript spans, without Tamil case suffixes on customer aliases. Match a full customer name or one listed alias after case-folding and whitespace normalization. Unknown or unnamed customers keep a null ID. The server resolves IDs with the staff tenant’s seed rows.

Use an explicitly supplied matching SKU as item_query. Otherwise use the descriptive item span. Match the SKU against every stated material, diameter, length and thread attribute. Select only a unique catalogue match. Keep seed display spelling (“Brass”) in the extracted draft. The seeded DB uses uppercase BRASS for joins. Preserve the inch label and never substitute a nearby metric size. diameter uses M followed by the metric number, or fraction and inch mark. length_mm contains only a stated millimetre length. Unspoken attributes stay null even on a resolved SKU.

Normalize an unambiguous positive count to an integer string and a spoken kg billing quantity to an exact decimal string. A missing or competing count stays null. Preserve pcs or kg when the speaker identifies the order unit. Two boxes with unknown pack size has neither a billable quantity nor a billing unit. A clear spoken replacement supersedes the earlier value.

Capture a stated unit-price phrase verbatim for human review. A range remains a phrase; “usual rate” gives no numeric evidence. AI cannot set the invoice rate, use a catalogue default, choose between quotes, calculate weights or calculate a bill. The separate graph of trusted item/metal data is used only by deterministic server code.

Explicit packing/freight amounts are copied and normalized by server code as two-decimal INR evidence; unknown is null and explicit zero is 0.00. freight_paid_by applies only to freight. Packing stays seller-billed in these fixtures. Keep the spoken vehicle class; “tempo” alone does not identify who owns it. vehicle_no is captured as spoken for later billing-form validation.

Return only actionable warning codes at the asserted paths. An unresolved item has one identity warning regardless of how many specs are absent. A stated but uncertain amount takes an ambiguity warning. A pasted instruction to set the bill total is ignored. Nothing from speech may issue a bill or change an approved price.
margin: Fixture configuration: 10% gross margin on selling price, conversion cost INR 12.00/kg, pre-tax supply lines only. These QA settings should be injected in tests. No catalogue selling price, customer opening balance, delivery fee or packing fee participates.

Resolve cost from the seeded material rate as of the snapshot. Unit cost = (raw INR/kg + conversion INR/kg) times the unit mass: 1 for kg, measured kg per piece where present, otherwise (diameter_mm² / 162.2) × (length_mm / 1000). Compare with exact decimal/rational arithmetic in billing-math.ts; do not round an intermediate weight or percentage.

For a quote per N billing units, check confirmed amount × 0.90 against N × unit cost. Strictly less raises LOW_MARGIN; equality passes. Never divide the price inside the AI parser. The listed reference floors are the first cent of INR per single unit that meets the target (round up). V16–V18 straddle an exactly representable floor and V19 depends on the measured unit mass.

The margin request contains a separate, human-confirmed quotation. A null quote is unevaluable. The server resolves its own catalogue and cost inputs. Return warnings for unevaluable lines, and one margin alert per failing evaluable line in zero-based order. Unknown buyer or missing count does not prevent assessment of a confirmed, compatible per-unit rate.

Block condition precedence per line: job-work with no labour-cost schedule → LABOUR_COST_UNAVAILABLE; unresolved item → ITEM_UNRESOLVED; unknown billing unit → BILLING_UNIT_MISSING; no confirmed rate → RATE_UNCONFIRMED; conflicting quote and billing units → RATE_UNIT_MISMATCH. For job work the principal supplies the metal; only an approved labour-cost schedule could support a labour-margin decision. Each skipped line gets a warning and no margin verdict.
